narr: An area of low pressure moved along a slow moving cold front bringing numerous showers and thunderstorms to Virginia. Multiple rounds of heavy rain occurred throughout the afternoon and evening and into the overnight across portions of central Virginia. Total rainfall amounts of two to five inches were observed where flooding occurred.
ev: US-29 in Madison was covered by at least six inches of flowing water across the road.
Preddy Creek was out of its banks with 6 to 12 inches of water flowing across Matthew Mill Road near Carpenters Mill Road.
Fort Run was out of its banks, with 6 to 12 inches of water flowing across Getz Drive in Timberville.
Roach River was out of its banks flooding portions of Bacon Hollow Road and VA-810 Dyke Road with 6 to 12 inches of flowing water.
The Robinson River was out of its banks with 6 to 12 inches of water flowing across the Whiteoak Fire Road and Whiteoak Canyon Trail.
Berry Farm Road closed due to flooding just east of the intersection with Spring Hill Road. About 12 inches of water was observed flowing across this road.
Fairfax EM reports moving water across Prosperity Avenue near Morningside Drive.

The stream gauge on Accotink Creek at Woodburn Road and Strathmeade Springs rapidly rose into flood stage. At least six inches of water was flowing across both Woodburn Road and VA-699 Prosperity Avenue.
Fort Run was flowing across Andrick Mill Road in Timberville.
Numerous roads closed due to high water flowing across them in Town of Shenandoah. East Side Highway closed at county lien due to Naked Creek flowing over road.
